name: Lens
author: James Myers
description: The accessibility layer Omarchy does not have. A magnifier, colour-vision correction for all three dichromacies, high contrast, invert, reduce motion, a bigger cursor and a way to find it again. All of it through hyprctl, none of it needing a password.

schema.label: Zoom step
schema.description: How far one notch of the scroll wheel moves the magnifier.

schema.label: Always show in the bar
schema.description: Off hides the widget until something is active. On by default, because a control you cannot find is not a control.

schema.label: Middle-click finds the cursor
schema.description: Pulses a ring where the pointer is. Useful on a large or multi-monitor desktop.

schema.label: Rigid magnifier
schema.description: The magnified view follows the pointer exactly rather than drifting toward it. Steadier, but it can feel abrupt.
